name: n4_find_dangling_outputs
description: List components (up to depth levels below ord) with an 'out' slot that no link in the subtree uses as a source. Links from outside the subtree are not seen. A source ORD that is neither a handle nor an absolute slot path cannot be resolved: outputs it may feed are listed as unknown, not dangling.

depth.description: Component levels below ord to scan (1-4)
